_meta.notes: Owned by readyup-practice (ships only in the practice component, next to the core's engine-surface.json). The grenade projectile factories behind ru_api grenade_spawn (API 1.12), and the team change / pawn teleport / entity create + spawn behind player_change_team, player_teleport, entity_create and entity_spawn (API 1.13). Each grenade Create is what CS2's own point_script SpawnGrenadeProjectile() calls (the caller_string anchor), with the same arguments: (const Vector* origin, const QAngle* angles, const Vector* velocity, const Vector* angular_velocity, CBaseEntity* thrower_pawn_or_null, int item_def_index); smoke takes a 7th int (team), HE gets 3.0f in xmm0 like the script call. The signatures cover the prologue's argument moves, so a changed ABI stops matching. The two virtuals (ChangeTeam, CCSPlayerPawn::Teleport) are also checked against their vtable slot (vtable_indices, class located by RTTI) and each call checks the object's vptr. None is in any plugin's needs.json "surface": a break turns off only that API (engine_feature_available() = 0), never the practice plugin. Check with build/readyup_sigcheck <libserver.so> gamedata/engine-surface.json gamedata/engine-surface.practice.json.

UTIL_CreateEntityByName.description: UTIL_CreateEntityByName(const char* classname, int forceEntityIndex = -1) -> CEntityInstance*: CGameEntitySystem::CreateEntityByName on the entity system global (lea of g_pGameEntitySystem, the same global UTIL_Remove reads). The entity is created, not spawned. Called (not hooked) by ru_api entity_create (practice .showspawns beams). Same signature as CounterStrikeSharp's.

CBaseEntity_DispatchSpawn.description: CBaseEntity::DispatchSpawn(CBaseEntity* entity, CEntityKeyValues* keyValues_or_null): spawns an entity made by UTIL_CreateEntityByName (null entity = no-op; null key values = an empty set). Called (not hooked) by ru_api entity_spawn. Its callers spawn the entities they just created by name (the anchors). Same signature as CounterStrikeSharp's.

CCSPlayerController_ChangeTeam.description: CCSPlayerController::ChangeTeam(this, int team) (vtable_indices CCSPlayerController::ChangeTeam): what jointeam ends in; team 1 = spectators, 2 = T, 3 = CT. It fires player_team (callee anchor) and schedules CSForceTeamThink. Called (not hooked) by ru_api player_change_team (practice .fas / .watchme, match .spec).

CCSPlayerPawn_Teleport.description: CCSPlayerPawn::Teleport(this, const Vector* origin, const QAngle* angles, const Vector* velocity) (vtable_indices CCSPlayerPawn::Teleport, CBaseEntity::Teleport's slot): calls the base Teleport with the same arguments first, then keeps the new view angles (a null pointer leaves that part alone). What CounterStrikeSharp's Teleport and ME's .spawn / lineups call to set a player's view. Called (not hooked) by ru_api player_teleport. No string of its own: identity is the unique signature, its CCSPlayerPawn field reads (mov_disp) and the vtable slot check.

CCSPlayerController::ChangeTeam.note: CBaseEntity::ChangeTeam's slot (CounterStrikeSharp CCSPlayerController_ChangeTeam offset 104). Checked (slot == the verified function, and the controller's vptr == this vtable) before every call.

CCSPlayerPawn::Teleport.note: CBaseEntity::Teleport's slot (CounterStrikeSharp CBaseEntity_Teleport offset 164). Checked (slot == the verified function, and the pawn's vptr == this vtable) before every call.
